label: Small test — XYZ-JPY vs USDJPY (1x)
description: A small, 1x preset to test XYZ-JPY/USDC:USDC vs MT5 USDJPY: 13 units per level ~ a 0.02-lot USDJPY hedge (about 2,000 USD; hedged by value through the project's FX pair); two grid levels per side, so at most 26 units each way; isolated margin; daily loss capped at 25 USD and 25,000 USD of volume per leg. Sizes assume a broker whose minimum lot is the usual one — Save checks them against the market the bot reports; start in DRY RUN.
